version: '3'

dotenv: ['.env']

tasks:
  up:
    desc: Start the standalone ClickHouse and JetStream dependencies, migrate, then start the service
    cmds:
      - docker compose up -d clickhouse nats
      - docker compose up nats-bootstrap
      - task: migrate-up
      - docker compose up -d --build ms-go-statistic

  down:
    desc: Stop the standalone stack while retaining its persistent volumes
    cmds:
      - docker compose down

  migrate-up:
    desc: Apply the repository-owned ClickHouse migrations through the standalone Docker network
    cmds:
      - docker compose run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint /app/ms-go-statistic-migrate ms-go-statistic

  migrate:native:
    desc: Apply the same ClickHouse migrations through the optional shared statistics profile
    cmds:
      - python3 scripts/native_config.py -- go run ./cmd/migrate

  migrate-down:
    desc: Rollback ClickHouse migrations (manual)
    cmds:
      - echo "ClickHouse migrations require manual rollback"

  # Legacy alias
  migrate:
    desc: "[DEPRECATED] Use migrate-up instead"
    cmds:
      - task: migrate-up

  run:
    desc: Run statistic service locally
    cmds:
      - go run ./cmd/ms-go-statistic

  run:native:
    desc: Run Statistic as a loopback-only host process using Docker ClickHouse and NATS
    cmds:
      - mkdir -p .cache/bin
      - go build -o .cache/bin/ms-go-statistic ./cmd/ms-go-statistic
      - python3 scripts/native_config.py -- .cache/bin/ms-go-statistic

  test:native-integration:
    desc: Prove the running native Statistic lifecycle against real ClickHouse and JetStream
    cmds:
      - go test -tags=nativeintegration ./test/integration -count=1

  test:
    desc: Run unit tests
    cmds:
      - go test ./...
      - python3 -m unittest test/unit/native_config_test.py

  lint:
    desc: Run linter
    cmds:
      - golangci-lint run ./...
